_ordering_rationale: Order par PV: US Omnipod (hero, plus gros segment, Omnipod 5 ramp), Intl Omnipod (croissance EU + nouveaux marches), Total Omnipod (vue agregee), Drug Delivery (legacy Amgen Neulasta, faible PV), Total revenue.

kpis.signal: Hero Insulet, Omnipod 5 dominant, expansion T2 (diabete type 2), CAGR ~30%
kpis.description_fr: CA Omnipod US (pompe insuline tubeless, plus gros marche). Croissance ~30% CAGR portee Omnipod 5 (boucle fermee automatisee) + expansion type 2.
kpis.description_en: US Omnipod revenue (tubeless insulin pump, largest market). ~30% CAGR growth driven by Omnipod 5 (automated closed-loop) + type 2 expansion.

kpis.signal: Re-acceleration FY24 (+27.6%) via lancement Omnipod 5 France, Pays-Bas, UK, Allemagne
kpis.description_fr: CA Omnipod International (principalement EU: Allemagne, UK, France, Pays-Bas). Re-acceleration FY24 lie au rollout Omnipod 5 dans nouveaux marches EU.
kpis.description_en: International Omnipod revenue (mainly EU: Germany, UK, France, Netherlands). FY24 re-acceleration driven by Omnipod 5 rollout in new EU markets.

kpis.signal: Cap $2Mds franchi FY24, base ~365k clients Omnipod 5 globaux
kpis.description_fr: CA total produits Omnipod (US + International). Franchi $2Mds en FY24. Base installee ~365k clients Omnipod 5 globalement fin FY24.
kpis.description_en: Total Omnipod products revenue (US + International). Crossed $2B in FY24. ~365k Omnipod 5 customers globally at FY24 end.

kpis.signal: Legacy non-strategique, pods Amgen Neulasta Onpro, declin structurel
kpis.description_fr: CA Drug Delivery: pods fournis a Amgen pour Neulasta Onpro (chimio). Activite legacy en declin structurel, ~2% du CA total.
kpis.description_en: Drug Delivery revenue: pods supplied to Amgen for Neulasta Onpro (chemo). Legacy activity in structural decline, ~2% of total revenue.

kpis.description_fr: CA total Insulet (Omnipod + Drug Delivery). CAGR ~23% sur 5 ans, hypercroissance soutenue par Omnipod 5.
kpis.description_en: Insulet total revenue (Omnipod + Drug Delivery). ~23% 5yr CAGR, sustained hypergrowth driven by Omnipod 5.
